construct: RULED, THE K2 CELL (refreshed 2026-09-21): k2_overview 40–70w (the persona's current in the element's arena) + k2_functional ≤22w (the god's own family function, re-ruled 2026-09-01) + k2_domain_readings 18–55w per ruled domain (owner construct 2026-08-19, corpus ×50 LOCKED) · adj_chips {catalyst ×3, friction ×3} 1–3w under THE KEYWORD DERIVATION CHAIN (2026-09-03) and THE VOCABULARY ZONE B1–B2 (2026-09-04) · fn_reading = the weighted three-door ledger {word, doors:{trait, scene, outside}} ×3 per pole, 35–55w per door (THE THREE DOORS 2026-09-03; corpus ×50 complete 2026-09-04) · structural_interaction = the REA_03 §4b authoring seed · k2_card = the unauthored register stub (REA_03 §4, superseded by the cell above). Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)
candidate_note: LOCKED corpus ×50 (k2 cell 2026-08-19; chips and ledger 2026-09-04); k2_card registers remain an unauthored stub.
sources: REA_03 §4b (interaction seeds — parsed from the doc)

candidates.structural_interaction: Water generating Wood cross-polarity — depth producing reach that exceeds its container
candidates.k2_overview: Your Wood moves as the Virtuoso: growth that will not stay trellised. You branch where the plan said hedge, flower out of season, and produce originality the way forests produce spring, excessively and without apology. Every constraint reads as a suggestion. Your best work grows exactly where they told you nothing could.
candidates.k2_functional: You express organically and abundantly, ideas leafing faster than any format can hold.

k2_domain_readings.Talent: Your talent is generative: new shoots daily, whole canopies of ideas. The gift needs an editor the way forests need clearings. Cut sightlines through your own abundance so the best trees show.
k2_domain_readings.Performance: You perform by unveiling growth: the project no one authorized, suddenly in bloom. Time the reveals. A garden shown at flowering converts skeptics that a garden shown as seeds cannot.
k2_domain_readings.Defiance: Your defiance is botanical: quiet, continuous, growing over walls rather than arguing with them. It wins by finished fact. Just verify the wall you are overgrowing is not holding your own soil.

angles.drive: You speak up where silence would be easier. Holding a true thing in feels worse to you, so you speak rather than wait for a welcome. If you let a few conversations go cold, you get to keep speaking up as yourself.
angles.cost_self: For you, speaking up is never free. Honesty matters more to you than being liked, so you say the hard thing and sit alone in the quiet after. Bring one ally before you speak up, and you give up fewer chances to it.
angles.cost_others: Speaking up for someone before being asked is a habit of yours. Because a wrong left standing bothers you more than overstepping, you say their piece ahead of them. Let them pick the moment, and your speaking up stays a gift instead of an interruption.

angles.drive: Going off script is where you shine. Since a fresh idea counts for more with you than a given plan, you leave the script instead of following it. Once you tell others you are going off script, you keep their trust along with your idea.
angles.cost_self: Off script is how you stay interested. Sticking to a plan switches your talent off, and you head off script rather than see it through. Finish one plan unchanged, because that keeps the chances only a plain version wins.
angles.cost_others: You go off script with shared plans as easily as your own. A better idea seems like a duty to you, and you go off script instead of asking. Check with the group first, so that you hand them a better plan to lean on.

angles.drive: Standing out comes naturally to you. You would rather stand out than fit in, since hiding what you can do is a small lie to yourself. Each time you stand out, you trade a little ease for a voice that is yours.
angles.cost_self: Being in a group means standing out, for you. Being noticed matters more than being safe, and you pick the stage where a quieter seat would cost less. Take the quiet seat now and then to hold on to the friendships standing out would cost.
angles.cost_others: You stand out in company that did not ask for a star. Attention steadies you, and you keep standing out rather than leave anyone a turn. Whenever you step back for a turn, you give the person beside you a chance to stand out.

angles.drive: Talking back is your first move. A rule you did not choose feels like being talked down to, so you answer it ahead of hearing it out. You win the moment by talking back and spend the week on the repairs.
angles.cost_self: Your self-respect runs on talking back. Giving in would mean losing yourself, and you would rather talk back than ask what the rule is for. Each time you talk back, you also turn away help that would have grown your talent.
angles.cost_others: You talk back to family as easily as to anyone in charge. Because a correction feels like an attack, you defend yourself ahead of hearing what was offered. You hand them an argument where they asked for your ear.

angles.drive: You show off without deciding to. Being the interesting one feels safer than being one of the group, so you show off rather than fit in. You collect praise with each show, and a quiet hour with one friend gives you what praise cannot.
angles.cost_self: Showing off is how you check you exist in a group. Since plain company leaves you feeling unseen, you show off instead of letting yourself be ordinary. With a show always running, you never find out how much you are liked as you are.
angles.cost_others: Most of your showing off goes to the people who love you. Because you feel applause more easily than closeness, you put on a show for them instead of talking. In place of a plain hour together, you give them a show.

angles.drive: Going too far is where you feel alive. You need a thing to be more than fine, so you go one step too far instead of stopping while it works. You wanted the moment itself, and going too far is how you lose it.
angles.cost_self: Making sure a thing was done means going too far. To you, stopping at enough wastes talent, so you go past it instead of resting. Past enough, you trade the good version you had for one you like less.
angles.cost_others: You go too far with people who have to live with it. Because a half-done thing bothers you more than a worn-out person, you push the shared plan past where they meant to stop. You spend their rest along with yours on the extra step.

edge.lead: Wood runs through your mind, your career and your social life. It is the idea from nowhere that turns out right, the brief you grow past before anyone signs off, and the rough true thing you say that friends repeat for weeks.
